flora: Mature Araucaria trees (tall, distinct spire-like crowns)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; tactile, high-quality textures like leathery bark; emphasis on thick, leathery, triangular, scale-like Araucaria leaves forming dense, distinct foliage; no sharp aggressive angles; overall majestic and ancient forest feel.

visual_logic.composition: A sweeping view of a dense grove of towering, mature Araucaria trees, their distinctive branches and scale-like foliage clearly visible, extending into a hazy distant horizon.
visual_logic.ground: Pale, dusty tan earth with white chalky nodules, interspersed with scattered fallen Araucaria scales/needles.
visual_logic.lighting: High-key direct sunlight creating a warm glow, with a hazy atmospheric perspective to enhance depth and scale.
